repeated_mistake_classes.failure: Public framework files mention local paths, private project names, or internal state surfaces.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Public release and framework quality checks reject host paths, private-state filenames, and unsanitized feedback intake.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A public template turns a source-specific tool, model, command, or product recipe into generic doctrine.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Source-update and framework semantic audit require abstraction, rejected source-specific surfaces, and ownership review before adoption.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A static article, title-slug post, PDF, release tag, or repository file path is treated as a recurring monitor root.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Source freshness lint rejects exact/static monitor roots unless a canonical exact-root metadata package is present.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: Source-monitor scope, exact-root freshness, replacement discovery, or cross-host approval is inferred from explanatory prose.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Source validators use closed Monitoring Mode, freshness-mechanism, replacement-discovery, and monitor-host-relation fields plus positive revalidation intervals and safe resolvable record references; cadence and explanatory prose cannot grant control status.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: Commentary, social posts, case studies, or AI summaries are used as doctrine without primary-source or project-evidence verification.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Source freshness lint binds every lower-tier source-pack or source-update row to its exact tier-compatible Allowed Use value; free-text action prose cannot override that structured boundary.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A browser research digest obtains completed, extracted, stale-input, verifier-role, claim, or evidence status from suggestive prose or product names.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: The schema-versioned source deep-research contract uses closed status, extraction, disposition, verifier-role, claim-class, method, and evidence-role fields; prose is retained only as evidence or contradiction input.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: Extra model, browser, or subagent reviewer lanes are launched without purpose, data boundary, output contract, budget, or stop condition.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Semantic review checks each launched lane against the purpose, data boundary, output contract, budget, and stop condition owned by task_orders/orchestrate.md; the guide ownership map routes prompt and agent quality guidance to that workflow.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A source-provided taxonomy, prompt text, example, command, or product workflow is copied instead of being abstracted and independently reviewed.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Source-update and source-pack templates require original abstraction plus explicit rejection of source-specific surfaces before any retained source or framework change.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A validator proves shape, count, or parsing while the semantic invariant remains unchecked.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Framework semantic audit covers every affected shared or reusable framework product surface and identifies the owning surface, repeated objective mistake class, proposed fixture, and stated semantic invariant; framework improvement and testing strategy own any authorized fixture implementation and verification before relying on the check.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: A durable generated system proves a fresh render but has no declared inspect, current-format refresh, recovery, or retirement contract, or silently assumes predecessor-format support.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: Framework semantic audit and testing strategy require objective evidence for every intentionally supported lifecycle transition; predecessor-to-current evidence is required only when that transition is intentionally supported, while unsupported formats require deterministic fail-closed evidence.

repeated_mistake_classes.failure: Framework readiness is inferred from Git status or selected-export checks without proving that every physical authoring-workspace root and fileless subtree is classified and that disposable generated residue is absent.
repeated_mistake_classes.guard: The final authoring-only compliance collector runs a stable workspace hygiene audit whose declared policy is the sole content input, rejects unknown roots, unapproved fileless subtrees, generated caches, lifecycle-declared disposable material, and filesystem anomalies, reserves transaction-control state for recovery, and reports exact approval-required cleanup candidates without deleting them.

owns: absence coverage activation, disclosure, and communication-effect gating
reusable reviewer and scoped-worker workflow quality
SwiftUI and Apple-platform UI implementation quality
